banner.title: queue-watchdog
banner.tagline: Fails its CronJob when a Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr queue item has been waiting for more than 24 hours, so KubeJobFailed pages on a stuck queue.

explainer.title: A failed Job is the alert

steps.title: Schedule
steps.text: A CronJob fires every 30 minutes with Forbid concurrency and a 600 s deadline, so one stuck pod cannot block the next run.
steps.scene: a clock face above a row of job tiles

steps.title: Read
steps.text: The script reads the Radarr v3, Sonarr v3 and Lidarr v1 queues, one page of up to 1000 records each, with keys from the secret.
steps.scene: an eye scanning three stacked queue trays

steps.title: Judge
steps.text: An item added more than 24 hours ago is stale. A queue it cannot read counts as an error, never as a healthy zero.
steps.scene: an hourglass beside a tray with a red marker

steps.title: Exit
steps.text: Exit 0 means healthy, 1 means a stale item, 2 means a queue was unreadable. A failed Job feeds the existing KubeJobFailed alert.
steps.scene: a warning beacon lit on a job tile

facts.label: no state, nothing to back up
